title: STARTEX — Glass House

fields.load: Moderate: 12 flights scheduled in the next 2 hours; 2,300 passengers estimated.

fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 1:00 PM on Wednesday, October 22, 2026, at the North Coast Regional Airport Authority. The airport is operating under normal conditions. Your roles are now active. Begin your initial assessment.

status.note: NVR-01 recording all zones; no camera outages.
